summary: This Phase 3 study looks at adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, which is a chronic disease causing inflammation and sores in the large intestine, along with obesity or overweight. The study will test giving the drugs mirikizumab and tirzepatide together compared to mirikizumab with a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like a real drug. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring this trial, which aims to enroll 350 participants. The study status is Recruiting.
